what: Dragging the card row sideways glides with inertia and snaps to the nearest card. Dragging the page-number handle of the dots below also moves the row to that card
ease: inertia(throwResistance 2500, maxDuration 1, edgeResistance .85) · power3.out .4s when moving by the handle
use:
Card…
— The page count may be omitted. When cards are filtered or changed el.dispatchEvent(new Event("fx:refresh"))

from.where: index.html product row — the original flickity (contain · no wrapAround · drag) is GPL so it is not bundled, and this part is used instead. Cards 19.375vw with 15px gaps, page count 01 — 06 is counted by the site’s index.js from the row position
